description.zh: 任务提交到YARN的IDs，用于过滤任务列表。
description.en: The IDs of the jobs that are submitted to YARN.

description.zh: 结束时间范围，过滤出结束时间在一个时间范围内的任务。
description.en: The range of end time. You can filter jobs whose end time falls within the specified time range.

description.zh: 一次获取的最大记录数。
description.en: The maximum number of entries to return on each page.

description.zh: 标记当前开始读取的位置。
description.en: The pagination token that is used in the request to retrieve a new page of results.

description.zh:
排序字段。取值：

- vcoreSeconds：任务CPU使用量。
- memSeconds：任务内存使用量。
description.en:
The field that you use to sort the query results. Valid values:

*   vcoreSeconds: the aggregated number of vCPUs that are allocated to the job multiplied by the number of seconds the job has been running
*   memSeconds: the aggregated amount of memory that is allocated to the job multiplied by the number of seconds the job has been running

description.zh:
排序方向。取值：

- ASC： 升序排列。
- DESC：降序排列。
description.en:
The order in which you want to sort the query results. Valid values:

*   ASC: the ascending order
*   DESC: the descending order

description.zh: 任务提交到YARN的队列列表，用于过滤任务列表。
description.en: The YARN queues to which the jobs are submitted.

description.zh: 开始时间范围，过滤开始时间在一个时间范围内的任务。
description.en: The range of start time. You can filter jobs whose start time falls within the specified time range.

description.zh: 任务提交到YARN的引擎列表，用于过滤任务列表。
description.en: The YARN engines to which the jobs are submitted.

description.zh: 任务提交的用户列表，用于过滤任务列表。
description.en: The users who submit the jobs.

title.zh: 批量获取任务运行结果
